Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning insurance for enlisted members of the Washington national guard.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to insurance for enlisted members of the Washingtonnational guard; and adding a new section to chapter 38.24 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 38.24 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) All enlisted members of grade E1 through E5 of the Washingtonnational guard who enlist after August 1, 2014, for a minimum period ofthree years, are eligible for additional compensation from the state ofWashington in the form of a payment of the monthly premium for theeligible member for a premiumbased health plan and premiumbaseddental plan provided by the federal military health system for militaryservice members, national guard, and reserve members who are not inactive duty. The state must select the premiumbased plans that applypursuant to this section. (2) The compensation described in subsection (1) of this sectionmust be paid by the state for the period of the member's enlistment,unless: (a) The member no longer qualifies for coverage under the terms of p. 1 SHB 2668the plan, including periods when the member is under active duty ordersfor a period over thirty consecutive days; (b) The member is enrolled or is eligible under a federal employeehealth or dental plan; or (c) The federal military health system no longer offers health ordental plans for service members, national guard, and reserve memberswho are not in active duty.
